oracle: Frozen bit-index reference with explicit sign-fill, 12 input bit patterns x (load + 3 shifts) = 48 checks per constructed case; known natural case uses unchanged 31-check independent probe.
controls: One positive and one inverted-sign-fill negative control for every distinct constructed width/shift contract; reused only for byte-identical TB.

limits: New cases are constructed mechanism validation, not unseen natural competition tasks or score gains.
